title: ProtoSemImage: Image-Valued Prototypes with Deformable Row Alignment for Interpretable Document Classification
title_zh: ProtoSemImage：具有可变形行对齐的图像值原型，用于可解释的文档分类

paragraphs.en: 该论文提出了一种将分类原型表示为图像的方法，通过文档图像的变形行对齐进行可解释的文档分类。 Prototypes in classification models are almost always vectors, and a vector has no readable form. This paper asks what happens when a prototype is an image. Documents give the question a natural form, because a document can be rendered as a multi-channel image in which every token becomes a pixel, so a class representative can take the same shape and the same channel semantics as the inputs it stands for. ProtoSemImage represents each class by one or more visual archetypes: prototype images in a four-channel HSV space whose channels carry named linguistic factors. A Skip-Gram objective learns that color space end to end through a four-dimensional bottleneck, discourse boundary rows become differentiable typed difference rows, and classification reduces to 2D visual template matching: a deformable row alignment between a document image and the archetype bank, in the spirit of dynamic time warping. Because the match is a spatial pattern comparison rather than a linear readout, the model reports where an input departs from its archetype and along which channel, and a generative head decodes each archetype back into text. The image representation works: it beats an otherwise identical model with vector prototypes in all three paired seeds, by between 4.3 and 11.8 points on a ten-class task. The distance-based matching does not. A diagnostic that keeps the representation fixed and swaps only the classifier recovers the sequence baselines, which locates a 20.6-point shortfall in the matching rather than in the color compression, and a benchmark built so that a pair of documents shares a bag of words and differs only in arrangement confirms the layout-preservation it was designed for. We report both directions, because for a representation whose whole purpose is inspect ability, the failure modes are as informative as the gains.
paragraphs.zh: 该论文提出了一种将分类原型表示为图像的方法，通过文档图像的形变行对齐实现可解释的文档分类。分类模型中的原型几乎总是向量，而向量本身没有可读形式。 本文探讨了当原型是一幅图像时会发生什么。 文档为这一问题提供了自然的表达形式，因为文档可以被渲染为多通道图像，其中每个词元都成为一个像素，因此类代表可以与其所代表的输入具有相同的形状和相同的通道语义。 ProtoSemImage 用一种或多种视觉原型来表示每个类别：这些原型图像位于四通道 HSV 空间中，其各通道承载有名称的语言学因素。 Skip-Gram 目标函数通过一个四维瓶颈端到端地学习颜色空间，话语边界行变为可微分的类型化差异行，分类问题则简化为二维视觉模板匹配：即文档图像与原型库之间的可形变行对齐，其理念类似于动态时间规整。 由于这种匹配是空间模式比较而非线性读取，模型能够报告输入与原型偏离的位置和具体通道，而生成头则可将每个原型解码回文本。 这种图像表示方法确实有效：在三个配对种子任务中，它均优于采用向量原型的其他相同模型，在十类别任务上的性能提升介于 4.3 到 11.8 分之间。 基于距离的匹配方法则未能实现这一点。 一项诊断实验固定了表示方式，仅交换分类器，结果恢复了序列基线水平，这表明 20.6 分的差距源于匹配而非颜色压缩；而一个设计为让文档对共享词袋且仅在排列上有所差异的基准测试，则证实了其布局保留的设计目标。 我们报告了两种方向的结果，因为对于一种以可检验性为核心目的的表示方法而言，其失效模式与成功之处同样具有信息价值。
